effects.effect: The vampire regains [Stamina](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.health/stamina) equal to half the damage dealt, and can end one effect on them that can be ended by a [saving throw](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.general/saving-throw).
effects.name: Effect

effects.effect: The vampire [shifts](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/movement/shifting) 3 after striking the last target, and can target one additional creature for every 2 malice spent.
Two blood-starved vampires appear in unoccupied spaces within distance.
effects.name: Effect

effects.effect: The target becomes the new target of the [strike](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/strike).
effects.name: Effect

features.name: Redirected Charm
features.trigger: A creature makes a [strike](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/strike) against the vampire.

effects.effect: The vampire has speed 15 and an [edge](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.dice/edge) on power rolls while any creature within 20 squares of them is [bleeding](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/condition/bleeding). Any [bleeding](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/condition/bleeding) creature within 5 squares of the vampire can't hide.
Each target who has P < 4 is now [bleeding](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/condition/bleeding) (save ends).
effects.name: Effect

effects.effect: The vampire turns to mist, filling the area. Until the end of the round, the vampire can't move or be targeted by abilities, but they can use Crimson Embrace against a target in the area. The vampire reforms in an unoccupied space in the area at the end of the round.
effects.name: Effect

effects.effect: Each target is marked for sacrifice. At the end of the round, each target who isn't dead or destroyed takes 50 corruption damage. The vampire then uses the following ability.
effects.name: Effect

effects.effect: Each target makes a **Might test**. This ability deals an extra 5 damage for each creature killed by the Sacrifice [villain action](scc.v1:mcdm.monsters.v1/rule.monster/villain-action).
effects.name: Effect
